institution_name: City College of Education, Mararaba, Nasarawa State
address: No. 1 City College Road, Off Old Karu Road, Sani Abacha Road Estate, Mararaba-Karu, Nasarawa State
vision: To be a distinctive quality based educational institution, making the difference in the Nation history through positive impact of its services and its graduate output.
mission: To establish and maintain a most suitable academic environment synergizing world class human capital best technology for creating and impacting knowledge to develop and produce superior entrepreneurial teachers for the Nigeria society.
history: City College of Education, Mararaba (CCoE) is a reputable tertiary teacher-education institution located in Mararaba-Karu, Nasarawa State, serving the Federal Capital Territory corridor and the entire federation. Established to address the growing demand for qualified, entrepreneurial, and technologically adept teachers in Nigeria, the College offers National Commission for Colleges of Education (NCCE) accredited NCE programmes as well as Undergraduate Degree and Postgraduate Diploma programmes in affiliation with Adekunle Ajasin University, Akungba-Akoko (AAUA), Ondo State.
philosophy: Anchored on our motto — "Education for Self Employment" — our philosophy emphasizes that teacher education must integrate deep academic mastery with practical vocational and digital entrepreneurship.
